answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 33141 Country: India Title: What is the ruling in case someone forget two rak’at of tawaf (it could be tawaf-e –ziyara, tawaf-e umra or any other tawaf)and realized it after returning home. Question: What is the ruling in case someone forget two rak’at of tawaf (it could be tawaf-e –ziyara, tawaf-e umra or any other tawaf)and realized it after returning home. Should he offer dam? Answer ID: 33141 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1387/851/H=1432) If you missed any nafl that is offered after tawaf, you should perform them immediately when you remember them after returning home. The delay in nafl does not make dam (slaughtering an animal) wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
